Well excuuuuse me, I didn't get the memo! It's not like I came in seconds to closing or that I was interrupting him while he was busy, there was nobody else in the place. So I just silently walked out, never to come back! Obviously I'm not welcome anymore. Way to think that one through, old BOY. I wished I had said something but this is more constructive. No use trying to reason with that cantankerous, condescending old codger attitude.

message.content: I did not realize the rules had changed. I did not arrive right before closing, nor did I interrupt any work; the shop was completely empty. Because of his attitude, I walked out quietly and will not return. I am clearly no longer welcome there. That was a foolish way to treat a customer. While I regret not speaking up at the moment, writing this is more useful than trying to argue with a hostile, condescending man.
